headline: Xinhua Daily Telegraph reports cancellation of a planned GPT-6.1 Astra after internal evaluation
summary: On October 8, 2026, the Digital China Summit website carried a Xinhua Daily Telegraph retrospective whose line 45 says OpenAI cancelled a planned October “GPT-6.1 Astra” in late September after it failed the company’s internal safety and alignment standards. The report provides no named attribution or linked primary source for the cancellation. OpenAI’s current newsroom lists the October 7 GPT-6 Sol/Luna update, and its API catalog documents GPT-6.1 Sol; the inspected first-party materials neither confirm nor refute a distinct planned “GPT-6.1 Astra.” The established fact is that Xinhua Daily Telegraph published this claim; the claimed cancellation and product identity remain unconfirmed.
